summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily repurchase transactions under its $1 billion buyback program, as required by ASX rules. The program authorizes open-market repurchases of Class A and B common stock. No specific price, premium, or closing date is stated. The board authorized the program earlier; no advisor is named. Mechanics involve daily ASX filings; the program is ongoing. Watch for execution pace and market conditions affecting buyback activity.
